inputs.text:
Open your eyes to what they are really trying to pull off. The mainstream narrative fed to us through Bloomberg wants us to swallow the lie that this Iran war is just a chaotic disaster of rising energy prices, canceled flights, and screen-filling destruction that everyone is supposedly begging to stop because it's unwinnable and a peril to global well-being. That is nothing more than a scripted illusion engineered by the hidden puppet masters.

The truth is hiding right out in the open in their own admissions: "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" They slipped up and exposed who is actually coordinating this agenda from behind the curtain. The official line claims the whole thing is poorly planned, but that is a complete inversion. Every single move is meticulously calculated by the global elites to keep the machine running. They need the conflict to continue, and they are using manufactured public backing to make sure it never stops.
